description: Match the rows of two tables on one or more pairs of key columns, like a join, and store the matches as JSON for 24 hours. left and right are lists of row objects; keys lists pairs such as {"left":"id","right":"customer_id"}. No API key, no account and no sign up.

keys.description: Pairs of key columns to match on, such as {"left": "id", "right": "customer_id"}.

left.description: The first table, as a list of row objects.

right.description: The second table, as a list of row objects.

name: match_tables
title: Match two tables
